research: Line: slate BYU -23.5; archive open -24.5, close -21.5. That is a 2-point move toward Montana State past the slate number, and Covers had -22.5 by 1 PM on game day. Judged against the close, the slate favors Montana State +23.5 (slate archive; Covers, Nov 12).
BYU is 3-0 with 300 points across wins over Ohio State, Omaha and Queens, making about 46% of its threes in each. Helps BYU (Predictem, Nov 12).

[angle] BYU didn't cover the 28.5 vs Queens two nights earlier. It won by 16, gave up 14 threes and was outrebounded by the smaller Queens. That is a defensive lapse against a perimeter team. Helps Montana State (Predictem, Nov 12).
BYU allows about 10 made threes a game, and Montana State makes about 11.5 a game. Helps Montana State (Predictem, Nov 12).
[angle] BYU's Dawson Baker, back from a season-ending knee injury, reportedly said he would play Thursday (per KSL). Extra guard depth helps BYU, but his minutes are uncertain (Predictem, Nov 12).

Robert Wright III averages about 25 ppg with under one turnover a game. Montana State's Jeremiah Davis (Big Sky Player of the Week), a physical guard, is the likely matchup. Mixed (Predictem, Nov 12).

[angle] Montana State's All-Big Sky guard Jed Miller missed the loss at Colorado State (by 10), then returned for a win over Long Beach State, going 4-of-8 from three. With Miller back, the dog can score. Helps Montana State (Predictem, Nov 12).

Montana State was picked to win the Big Sky in both polls and returns 10 players from an 18-14 team. The writer says it has covered both of its games. A veteran team helps the dog (Predictem, Nov 12).

This is the fastest opponent Montana State has faced, by 114+ spots in tempo, and its best opponent so far is Colorado State. BYU ranks 33rd in free-throw rate defense, while Montana State fouls a lot (about 300 spots worse). Helps BYU (Covers, Nov 12).
Ratings: KenPom projects BYU 90-72 (18); Torvik ranks them 23rd and 127th. Both are inside the number but priced (Predictem, Nov 12).
BYU is 4-1 ATS in its last five, covering 33.5 vs Omaha. Team ATS trends are priced (Covers and Predictem, Nov 12).
The previews split: Predictem took Montana State +23.5 (projects 89-71, passes below +20), and Covers took BYU -22.5 with the Under (Covers and Predictem, Nov 12).
games.reasoning: KenPom's 18 and the close's move to 21.5 both sit below the slate's 23.5. Montana State has its All-Big Sky guard back and a three-point offense against a BYU defense that just allowed 14 threes. But this is a 20+ spread on a team on short rest, and LESSONS says big college dogs and slate-number edges haven't paid, so I pass with Montana State as the forced side. A clear report on Baker's minutes, or the close holding at 23.5+, would have changed it.
